question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word in brackets to fill in the blank.

The chef prepared a ________ (spicy) curry with bland flavours for those who preferred less heat.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Mild**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Spicy"** refers to food that has a strong, hot flavor due to the addition of spices. (मसालेदार)

 
 
• **Example:** The spicy curry made everyone reach for water to cool their tongues.
 
 
 
• The word **"Mild"** is the antonym of spicy and refers to food that has a gentle or soft flavor, without strong or hot spices. (हल्का)
 
 
• **Example:** The soup had a mild taste, making it perfect for children.
 
 
 
• Hence, the opposite of **'spicy'** is **'mild'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Mild**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Pungent** (तीव्र): Having a sharply strong taste or smell.

 
 
• **Example:** The pungent aroma of garlic filled the kitchen.
 
 
 
• **Zesty** (जोशीला): Having a strong, pleasant, and somewhat spicy flavor or quality.
 
 
• **Example:** The zesty lemon sauce added a refreshing tang to the dish.
 
 
 
• **Fiery** (अति तीखा): Very hot or spicy in flavor.
 
 
• **Example:** The fiery chili sauce was too much for her to handle.
